statement: Google has committed to order more than 3 million units of Intel EMIB-T advanced packaging for its next-generation TPU, with expected delivery in 2028.
why: A multi-million-unit hyperscaler commitment establishes Intel EMIB-T as a second source of advanced packaging outside TSMC CoWoS, which is the binding constraint on AI accelerator output.

impact.mechanism: Qualifying a non-TSMC advanced-packaging path adds capacity on which AI logic chips can be assembled, easing the CoWoS bottleneck for accelerator supply from 2028.

evidence.excerpt: more than 3 million units of Intel's EMIB-T packaging

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet relaying company statements and TrendForce/Reuters-based reporting; no filing confirms the order.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 5.8 -> 3000000.0 (tol 1%); sources: CryptoBriefing, Intel Investor Relations
